1345 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
03-19-1345 minus 102 days:  
March has 31 days, so back to Feb 28 (1345 not leap).  
From 03-19 back 19 days → March 1.  
Remaining 102 - 19 = 83 days earlier.  
Feb 28 back 28 days → Jan 31.  
Remaining 83 - 28 = 55 days earlier.  
Jan 31 back 31 days → Dec 31, 1344.  
Remaining 55 - 31 = 24 days earlier.  
Dec 31 back 24 days → Dec 7, 1344.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1344-12-07
